body:
> [!IMPORTANT] > Removing the Library's window drop handling means a file dropped on the Library is no longer `preventDefault`ed, so Electron navigates the window to the file instead of "doing nothing". **Reviewed changes** This is the initial review of the full PR. It replaces the Prepare screen with a dedicated Export screen and rail entry. - **Export routes and legacy redirect.** Adds `/export/:assetId` and `/export`. `/prepare*` now redirects there and keeps `?to=`. `preparePath`/`prepareNewPath` now return Export URLs. - **Export screen.** Adds a fixed header, a stage and a row of seven destination cards. A document-level keydown handler maps Enter to the primary action and ←/→ to the selection. - **No-video state.** Adds a drop zone, a Library picker, Browse files and Recent exports, all built on the existing `usePrepareImport` window drop. - **Email destination.** Adds a new `email` `DestinationId` over the `balanced` preset. `usePrepareCopy` takes a `destination` override so the progress and ready cards can name it. - **Rail badge.** The badge moves from LIBRARY to EXPORT and now also counts the running export. - **Library cleanup.** Removes the drop strip, the Prepare and Import buttons, the `useFileDrop` wiring and `ImportDropZone`. ### ℹ️ Leftover references to the removed Library import The diff deletes these pieces but leaves references to them behind. Nothing breaks at runtime.
Technical details ````markdown # Leftover references to the removed Library import ## Affected sites - `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/import-video.md:112`: still lists `.../features/library/components/import-drop-zone.tsx`, which this PR deletes. - `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:1487` and `es.json:1487`: `backgroundCopy.libraryBadge` has no callers now that the sidebar uses `export.railBadge`. ## Required outcome - No docs pointing at deleted files, and no orphaned catalog keys. ````
